name.description: Name of the endpoint in the format projects/{project_id}/locations/{locationId}/endpoints/{endpointId}.
name.rationale: Consistent naming improves resource management and identification.

network.description: Name of the VPC network that is connected to the IDS endpoint.
network.rationale: Using a properly configured network ensures effective monitoring and security.

severity.description: The minimum alert severity level that is reported by the endpoint.
severity.rationale: Higher severity levels ensure critical threats are detected and reported.

location.rationale: Choosing the correct location ensures compliance and better performance.

description.description: An optional description of the endpoint.
description.rationale: Providing a description improves clarity and documentation.

threat_exceptions.description: Configuration for threat IDs excluded from generating alerts.
threat_exceptions.rationale: Should be used carefully to avoid missing important threats.

project.description: If not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Specifying the project ensures proper organization and access control.
